**Summary:**  
Before transitioning into software and intelligent systems, I worked in heavy civil construction, gaining hands-on experience with large-scale infrastructure, utilities, and site development. This background continues to influence how I approach complex, real-world systems.

::: {.badges}
**Work Focus:** Excavation · Sewer & Water Lines · Site Development · Public Infrastructure
:::

### BYU Waterline Installation
Installation of underground waterlines on campus, including trenching, pipe placement, bedding, and coordination around active facilities.

![](/images/projects/construction/heavy-civil/byu-waterline.jpg){fig-alt="BYU campus waterline installation"}

### Sewer Line Replacement
Replacement of aging sewer infrastructure requiring careful excavation, grade control, and safe work around existing utilities.

![](/images/projects/construction/heavy-civil/sewer-line.jpg){fig-alt="Sewer line replacement"}

### Housing Development
Early-stage site work for residential developments, including mass excavation, utility rough-ins, and preparation for foundations and roadways.

![](/images/projects/construction/heavy-civil/housing-dev.jpg){fig-alt="Housing development site work"}

### Lakeside Power Station
Heavy excavation and utility work supporting power-generation infrastructure, with strong emphasis on safety and sequencing.

![](/images/projects/construction/heavy-civil/lake-side-power-station.jpg){fig-alt="Lakeside power station construction"}

### New Public Park
Site preparation and infrastructure installation for a new public park designed for long-term community use.

![](/images/projects/construction/heavy-civil/new-park.jpg){fig-alt="New public park construction"}
